effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.summary: Smooth, conventional uniform blur. Fast and reliable; repeat edge pixels if borders appear.

effects.name: Fast Box Blur
effects.summary: Efficient box approximation; useful in matte softening, textures and previews.

effects.name: Directional Blur
effects.summary: Linear blur along an angle; simulated speed smear/trails.

effects.name: CC Radial Blur
effects.summary: Radial directional or zoom-streak blur based on a center; useful for impact effects.

effects.name: CC Radial Fast Blur
effects.summary: Faster radial-style effect; fewer/other controls than standard.

effects.name: Radial Blur
effects.summary: Older rotational/zoom radial blur option; still useful in some looks, not automatically obsolete.

effects.name: CC Vector Blur
effects.summary: Uses vectors/texture for stylized flow-like warping/blurring.

effects.name: Compound Blur
effects.summary: Uses a secondary layer's brightness to change blur amount across the image.

effects.name: Channel Blur
effects.summary: Independently blurs R/G/B/A channels; potential color fringes and alpha softening.

effects.name: Bilateral Blur
effects.summary: Smooths regions while retaining prominent edges.

effects.name: Smart Blur
effects.summary: Smooths relatively uniform regions but attempts to protect edges.

effects.name: Sharpen
effects.summary: Basic edge enhancement; halos appear if overdone.

effects.name: Unsharp Mask
effects.summary: Controlled edge contrast sharpening, Amount/Radius/Threshold.

effects.name: Camera-Shake Deblur
effects.summary: Attempts to mitigate motion-induced camera blur; may create artifacts.

effects.name: CC Cross Blur
effects.summary: Cross-shaped/anamorphic-style blur direction.

effects.name: CC Composite
effects.summary: Composites the processed result against the layer's underlying original input inside one effect pipeline; try RGB-only/alpha and blend settings when nothing seems to happen.

effects.name: Blend
effects.summary: Blends the current layer with another input layer.

effects.name: Set Matte
effects.summary: Pull alpha or luminance from a specified source and inject it into effect pipeline.

effects.name: Shift Channels
effects.summary: Route/copy individual channels; build simple RGB split/aberration effects.

effects.name: Set Channels
effects.summary: Assemble output channels from multiple source channels/layers.

effects.name: Channel Combiner
effects.summary: Converts/composes color channels, including channel-to-lightness conversions.

effects.name: Invert
effects.summary: Invert color values or selected channels, including alpha where chosen.

effects.name: Minimax
effects.summary: Grow/shrink bright or dark regions, useful for matte expansion/erosion.

effects.name: Remove Color Matting
effects.summary: Correct halo caused by premultiplication against an unwanted matte color.

effects.name: Calculations
effects.summary: Combine input layer channels and mathematical/compositing operations.

effects.name: Solid Composite
effects.summary: Composites layer over specified solid color within the layer bounds; useful for creating black/white map backgrounds.

effects.name: Mocha Shape
effects.summary: Workflow-specific Mocha-created masks/mattes if available.

effects.name: Keylight (1.2)
effects.summary: General green/blue screen chroma key with detailed Screen Matte controls.

effects.name: Key Cleaner
effects.summary: Recover/clean key edges, especially fine outlines.

effects.name: Advanced Spill Suppressor
effects.summary: Remove undesirable green/blue color contamination on subject edges.

effects.name: Linear Color Key
effects.summary: Remove specified RGB color/range; controlled simple key.

effects.name: Color Difference Key
effects.summary: Difference-based blue/green keying.

effects.name: Color Range
effects.summary: Target color range; sometimes useful for selections but can be noisy.

effects.name: Difference Matte
effects.summary: Remove area resembling clean background reference.

effects.name: Extract
effects.summary: Use luminance thresholds to isolate bright/dark regions.

effects.name: Inner/Outer Key
effects.summary: Separate inner/outer edges for difficult mattes.

effects.name: CC Simple Wire Removal
effects.summary: Remove linear cables/wires across footage.

effects.name: Color Key
effects.summary: Obsolete. Retained for compatibility; not mandatory in modern key workflow.

effects.name: Lumetri Color
effects.summary: Comprehensive familiar color grading (basic, curves, color wheels, HSL secondary, vignette where available).

effects.name: Curves
effects.summary: Precise tonal/channel mapping, matte contrast, look creation.

effects.name: Exposure

effects.name: Hue/Saturation
effects.summary: Target hue, saturation and lightness globally or ranges.

effects.summary: Tonal monochrome conversion with channel weights.

effects.summary: Basic global correction; limited compared with Curves.

effects.summary: Prioritize less-saturated color areas over skin tones in many cases.

effects.name: Selective Color
effects.summary: Fine color-group adjustment.

effects.summary: Change RGB output from channel mixtures, make custom grayscale.

effects.summary: Retain one selected hue while desaturating others.

effects.summary: Map luminance/phase to customizable color palette.

effects.name: Color Link
effects.summary: Match/link colors in layer-based workflows.

effects.summary: Correct fluctuating color using sample areas.

effects.name: Equalize
effects.summary: Redistribution of intensity histogram; stylized image contrast.

effects.name: Photo Filter
effects.summary: Warm/cool photographic filter color.

effects.summary: Recover local dark/light detail; can flatten images.

troubleshooting.checks: Layer eye, Solo, enabled comp, work area, layer in/out, opacity, blend modes, track matte, guide layer, 3D view, collapsed transformations, alpha, effects
troubleshooting.fix: Start by switching to Active Camera/Front as appropriate and temporarily bypass suspect mattes/effects.

troubleshooting.symptom: Layer is black where it should be transparent
troubleshooting.checks: Transparency Grid is a *preview aid*; comp background color isn't alpha, solid-color source may be opaque
troubleshooting.fix: Toggle Transparency Grid and inspect Alpha channel, not simply black RGB. Choose output format with alpha if needed.

troubleshooting.checks: Codec/container doesn't preserve alpha; transparency interpreted as black in player
troubleshooting.fix: Use ProRes 4444 or appropriate PNG/EXR sequence with RGB+Alpha and correct alpha interpretation. Standard H.264 MP4 doesn't export an alpha channel.

troubleshooting.checks: Track Matte source assignment, Alpha vs Luma, invert, source visibility, matte layer alpha/brightness
troubleshooting.fix: Select the matted layer, choose its matte source with pick whip/dropdown. Matte source may be elsewhere in layer stack.

troubleshooting.checks: Effects & Presets search, installed plugin, effect hidden in Obsolete group, renderer or bit-depth limitations
troubleshooting.fix: Confirm exact effect name/category; inspect supported 8/16/32-bpc and GPU icons, then verify plugins.

troubleshooting.checks: Property is collapsed, layer not selected, Timeline search filter, expression-only animation
troubleshooting.fix: `U` shows keyed properties; `UU` modified properties; `EE` expressions. Clear Timeline search.

troubleshooting.checks: Relevant properties are not exposed
troubleshooting.fix: Reveal keyframes with `U` and clear search/filter.

troubleshooting.checks: Wrong panel focus; text cursor active; laptop Fn mapping; OS intercept; custom shortcut
troubleshooting.fix: Click correct panel; press `Esc` to leave text edit; check Edit → Keyboard Shortcuts.

troubleshooting.symptom: `G/Q` draws a mask instead of a shape
troubleshooting.checks: Existing footage/solid layer selected vs no layer selected; Tool Creates Shape/Mask setting
troubleshooting.fix: Deselect layers for a new shape layer; deliberately choose Shape or Mask mode.

troubleshooting.checks: Procedural Rectangle Path rather than Bézier path
troubleshooting.fix: Convert shape path to Bézier Path, then select Path and vertex. Preserve parametric form if you still need width/corner sliders.

troubleshooting.symptom: Path pasted into Position doesn't follow correctly
troubleshooting.checks: Wrong path/property selection; position separation; space transforms; dimensions
troubleshooting.fix: Copy actual Path property, paste on Position with playhead at desired time, inspect spatial path.

troubleshooting.symptom: Auto-Orient flips or points the wrong way
troubleshooting.checks: Original artwork direction, tangent, parent transform, spatial path
troubleshooting.fix: Use Auto-Orient Along Path and rotate source art/precomp for desired leading direction.

troubleshooting.checks: 3D switch vs geometry extrusion, render engine, mesh type, camera/light
troubleshooting.fix: A 3D switch creates a plane; actual geometric depth requires supported geometry/renderer and property controls.

troubleshooting.checks: Layer material settings, 3D renderer, light type, lighting switch or blend style
troubleshooting.fix: Verify compatible renderer and Accepts Lights/material properties.

troubleshooting.checks: Layer motion-blur switch, comp master motion-blur switch, shutter angle, type of animation
troubleshooting.fix: Enable both switches and verify shutter angle/samples; FX blur may behave differently.

troubleshooting.checks: Propagation, segmentation boundary, view resolution, clip cuts, occlusion, strokes too broad
troubleshooting.fix: Work close to source/full resolution, make small corrections, propagate in short spans, refine and freeze.

troubleshooting.checks: Too aggressive Clip Black/White, Shrink/Grow, despill, suppression
troubleshooting.fix: Inspect Keylight Screen Matte; aim for clean black background, white subject and sensible grey edges.

troubleshooting.checks: Premultiplied RGB contamination, poor despill, matte chatter, uncorrected edge colors
troubleshooting.fix: Check straight/premultiplied interpretation, use edge color decontamination/despill, slight blur/choke only if needed.

troubleshooting.symptom: Animation seems to speed up unpredictably
troubleshooting.checks: Unequal keyframe timing, nonlinear Graph Editor easing, path distances, frame rate
troubleshooting.fix: Examine motion-path dots, timing, speed graph and roving keys. Equal time between keys ≠ constant spatial speed.

troubleshooting.checks: Timeline snapping / graph options
troubleshooting.fix: Graph Editor → Choose Graph Type and Options → Allow Keyframes Between Frames (when supported). Rendering still samples actual frame times.

troubleshooting.checks: Large footage, many layers, effects, GPU memory, disk cache, insufficient RAM, compressed media
troubleshooting.fix: Start with 1/4 preview and shorter work area; disable heaviest effects; test transcoded sources; inspect cache/disk.

troubleshooting.checks: Variable frame rate footage, interpretation mismatch, mixed sample rates, time stretching
troubleshooting.fix: Convert VFR footage to constant frame rate; confirm comp rate, audio 48 kHz where appropriate; inspect source timing.

troubleshooting.checks: Missing font or font-axis support, font version mismatch, plugin effects
troubleshooting.fix: Package font/license details, verify exact font and open a test copy on target machine.

troubleshooting.checks: Work area vs entire comp; proxy; guide layers; 3D/camera, output color/bit depth; motion blur/sample settings
troubleshooting.fix: Render a short test with the intended output module and compare RGB/alpha/color.

troubleshooting.checks: Corrupt frame, GPU driver, unsupported plugin, insufficient disk space, bad source segment
troubleshooting.fix: Narrow to failing frame/time, disable suspected effect, render a short image sequence, review log, update plugin/driver responsibly.

troubleshooting.symptom: After Effects will not launch on Windows
troubleshooting.checks: Check installed version, supported CPU/AVX2, required GPU API, permissions and plugin crashes.
troubleshooting.fix: Try Adobe supported startup diagnostics and a clean test of third-party plugins; 25.6 requires OpenCL 2.0 where used.

troubleshooting.checks: Verify 25.6 hardware requirements and installed GPU driver/OpenCL capabilities.
troubleshooting.fix: Use a supported GPU with the required API, not a workaround that disables GPU capability checks.

troubleshooting.checks: Version is 25.6, while Quick Apply started in 26.2.
troubleshooting.fix: Use Effects & Presets panel search; optionally verify custom keyboard mappings.

troubleshooting.checks: Object Matte first shipped in 26.2, not in 25.6.
troubleshooting.fix: Use Roto Brush, Refine Edge, Mask Tracking or Mocha AE.

troubleshooting.symptom: Cannot find native SVG shape import
troubleshooting.checks: Direct SVG as editable shapes is a 26.0 feature.
troubleshooting.fix: Import compatible vector art through supported older workflows such as Illustrator art and convert shapes where available.

troubleshooting.symptom: Cannot find new Unmult or Curl Noise
troubleshooting.checks: Unmult began in 26.0; Curl Noise in 26.3.
troubleshooting.fix: Use Set Matte / keying or Fractal/Turbulent Noise alternatives and document their differences.

troubleshooting.checks: The additional built-in audio effects were introduced in 26.0.
troubleshooting.fix: Use 25.6 existing Audio effects, or prepare audio in a dedicated editor.

troubleshooting.checks: Guide overhaul with percentages and edge pinning was 26.5.
troubleshooting.fix: Use standard guide/ruler and grid controls available in 25.6.

troubleshooting.checks: The 26.5 update added bundled ACES 2.0/OCIO 2.5.1 support.
troubleshooting.fix: Use supported 25.6 OCIO/ACES configurations and carefully validate any externally supplied config.

troubleshooting.symptom: Text editor shortcuts change layer behavior
troubleshooting.checks: Text cursor has focus, so Ctrl+Shift+K or letter keys act on text.
troubleshooting.fix: Exit text editing with a valid method, select Timeline panel, and try again.

troubleshooting.symptom: Shape Layer created but nothing is visible
troubleshooting.checks: Empty Contents group, missing Fill/Stroke, hidden layer or path size 0.
troubleshooting.fix: Draw a path, enable Fill/Stroke, inspect Contents and layer visibility.

troubleshooting.symptom: New rectangle is a mask instead of a shape
troubleshooting.checks: A valid existing image/solid layer was selected or toolbar mode is Tool Creates Mask.
troubleshooting.fix: Deselect layers or change toolbar mask/shape mode intentionally.

troubleshooting.symptom: Rotating layer moves it in a strange circle
troubleshooting.checks: Anchor is far from intended rotation pivot.
troubleshooting.fix: Inspect A and P; use Y Pan Behind to move anchor while preserving apparent position.

troubleshooting.checks: Parent and child coordinate spaces or existing keyframes differ.
troubleshooting.fix: Inspect parent transforms and resulting local coordinates; undo and establish a clean rig hierarchy.

troubleshooting.symptom: Imported image looks too small or too large
troubleshooting.checks: Footage and comp dimensions differ; non-square pixels or layer Scale may be involved.
troubleshooting.fix: Inspect footage pixels, comp pixels, pixel aspect ratio and fit-to-comp commands.

troubleshooting.checks: Non-square pixel interpretation or comp setting mismatch.
troubleshooting.fix: Correct Interpret Footage and composition pixel aspect ratio; verify intended final output.

troubleshooting.symptom: Image sequence imports as one still
troubleshooting.checks: Sequence option not enabled or numbering not continuous.
troubleshooting.fix: Select the first frame and enable appropriate image-sequence import options.

troubleshooting.checks: Time-Reverse Layer or descending Time Remap curve.
troubleshooting.fix: Inspect Time Remap and selected layer time operations, then restore correct source order.

troubleshooting.symptom: Loop has one blank or extra frame
troubleshooting.checks: Default last Time Remap key points to source duration after last visible frame.
troubleshooting.fix: Correct the loop-end time, then recheck first and last frames.

troubleshooting.symptom: Motion path appears curved but motion is uneven
troubleshooting.checks: Spatial path curvature and temporal easing are separate.
troubleshooting.fix: Review path geometry and Graph Editor speed; do not equate key spacing with constant travel.

troubleshooting.checks: Confusing effect Stroke with shape Trim Paths or a hidden Fill/Stroke.
troubleshooting.fix: Inspect the intended mask or shape path, stroke width, Trim Paths Start/End and operator location.

troubleshooting.checks: New source dimensions differ while layer scale values were preserved.
troubleshooting.fix: Use replacement source at expected dimensions or deliberately adjust Scale/anchor.

troubleshooting.checks: Wrong layer/effect name or scalar returned to vector property.
troubleshooting.fix: Pick whip to actual Slider; return [s,s] for 2D Scale.

troubleshooting.symptom: Source text background does not fit
troubleshooting.checks: sourceRectAtTime width/height used without left/top offsets or coordinate conversion.
troubleshooting.fix: Use both dimensions and positional offsets in the same coordinate context.

troubleshooting.symptom: FX renders differently with Collapse Transformations
troubleshooting.checks: Nested transform/render order was changed.
troubleshooting.fix: Disable switch temporarily and compare effects, layer masks and 3D interactions.

troubleshooting.checks: Glow is applied to too much bright imagery or effect stack has wrong order.
troubleshooting.fix: Isolate highlights, adjust Threshold/Radius/Intensity, and compare precomp/stack order.

troubleshooting.symptom: Screen replacement slips on camera movement
troubleshooting.checks: Tracker plane drift or incorrect Corner Pin surface.
troubleshooting.fix: Review original checkerboard on every frame, recalibrate plane and retrack if necessary.

troubleshooting.checks: Propagation range incomplete or erroneous Freeze state.
troubleshooting.fix: Review corrected base frame and full span, and unfreeze/refreeze safely as required.

troubleshooting.symptom: Content-Aware Fill looks like repeated blotches
troubleshooting.checks: Missing clean reference or fill algorithm cannot reconstruct motion/texture.
troubleshooting.fix: Use a reference frame/clean plate, smaller mask, or alternative tracked patch.

troubleshooting.checks: Unintended color transform, output profile or double-applied LUT.
troubleshooting.fix: Audit source, working, display and output transforms and inspect metadata.

troubleshooting.checks: Audio layer muted or Render Queue/Output Module audio setting disabled.
troubleshooting.fix: Confirm layer Audio switch, export setting and resulting media audio track.

troubleshooting.symptom: Export image sequence has missing frames
troubleshooting.checks: Render interruption, nonmatching numbering or wrong range.
troubleshooting.fix: Check continuous frame count, output directory and any render failures before assembling.

troubleshooting.symptom: RGBA preview shows black in media player
troubleshooting.checks: Media player may ignore alpha even when alpha exists.
troubleshooting.fix: Import rendered result in AE or another alpha-aware consumer over a colored solid.

troubleshooting.checks: High-res/32-bpc source, big comp and insufficient RAM.
troubleshooting.fix: Limit preview range/resolution, manage memory settings and use proxies/pre-renders.

troubleshooting.checks: Cache drive low on space, quota small or large prior assets.
troubleshooting.fix: Move cache to a fast drive with room or purge deliberately while AE is idle.

troubleshooting.symptom: Collect Files reopens with missing fonts
troubleshooting.checks: Font software is not bundled by Collect Files.
troubleshooting.fix: Install licensed fonts on target and record exact family/version in README.

troubleshooting.symptom: One plugin works only on other PC
troubleshooting.checks: Plugin binary, GPU, licensing or CPU/OS differs.
troubleshooting.fix: Check Windows-compatible plugin version and authorized installation; pre-render a fallback when necessary.

troubleshooting.checks: Caps Lock, wrong viewer, cached frame issue or no valid current layer.
troubleshooting.fix: Turn Caps Lock off, select correct comp and time, then test on a single plain solid.

troubleshooting.checks: A Windows/app shortcut may intercept it or focus in another panel.
troubleshooting.fix: Check Edit → Keyboard Shortcuts, reset/rename mapping and test within intended panel.

troubleshooting.symptom: MOGRT name edit changes all copies
troubleshooting.checks: Shared child source edited instead of instance Essential Property.
troubleshooting.fix: Expose text properly and use instance overrides on each nested copy.

troubleshooting.checks: Unsupported renderer, 2D layer, Material Options or light settings.
troubleshooting.fix: Enable 3D/material options and use an appropriate light/renderer combination.

troubleshooting.checks: Uncollected source, LUT, font, plugin or unrecorded settings.
troubleshooting.fix: Collect Files, document dependencies and rerender a test from the transferred package.

After Effects renderer for supported imported 3D models and relevant material/lighting features.
Native After Effects project file storing editable compositions and source references rather than embedding every source file.
Transparency; 0 = fully transparent; 1.0 as normalized alpha (or 255 in 8-bit alpha) = fully opaque.
Matte type that inverts alpha-derived transparency.
Matte type that derives target coverage from source alpha.
Whether RGB values already have transparency mathematically baked into the colors.
Local pivot point for scaling/rotation.
The point to which calculated motion data is applied.
Geometry or motion curve controlled by points and tangent handles.
Processing precision per color channel; not equivalent to source codec's bit depth.
Estimated 3D camera motion reconstructed from analyzed footage.
AE camera projection parameter affecting framing/field of view.
Matte processing effect that contracts/expands or cleans alpha edges.
Codec/container color-encoding metadata describing characteristics such as primaries and transfer functions.
Change how transformations are propagated through nested comps; can alter appearance and layer ordering behavior.
Project dependency action that copies linked assets into a transportable collected project folder.
Map between encodings or looks; creative LUT ≠ necessarily a correct camera input transform.
Composition viewer's background preference; not automatically opaque pixels in output.
Canvas and frame-based timeline that combines several layers into a rendered result.
Diagnostic display to help identify computationally expensive layers or effects.
Related switch that causes eligible vector art to be rasterized at an appropriate scale, retaining sharper edges.
Re-render vector layers at the required effective resolution for sharp results when scaled; cannot restore detail to an arbitrary raster photo.
Perspective effect mapping image corners to specified tracked points.
Current Time Indicator; the time whose frame is displayed/evaluated.
Remove green/blue color contamination from a keyed object's edges.
Persisted reusable frame data stored on a disk; distinct from source assets and final renders.
Conversion from a working scene/image to a viewing device's intended display rendering.
Faster approximate viewer/sampling quality when supported; verify final output.
Keyframe assistant that creates a smooth transition into/out of a keyframe.
Panel for one or more applied effect instances and their properties.
Interface for managing effect availability/enablement in supported builds.
Searchable After Effects panel listing installed effects and animation presets.
Illumination sampled from an image or environment in a supported 3D renderer.
AE interface used to expose properties for templates and nested instance editing.
Exposed properties of a precomp that can be overridden per instance.
Scripted formula linked to a property, evaluated at render/preview time.
Slider, Angle, Color, Point and related controls designed for linking rigs.
Text Animator selector driven by a custom expression.
OpenEXR image format often used with floating-point channels and VFX passes.
Adobe scripting dialect used in JSX automation of application/project structure.
Tracking patch containing the visual detail being matched across frames.
Media reference inside the Project panel; one item can appear in multiple compositions.
Viewer for opening an imported file's source frames, distinct from a composition view.
Method of blending/interpolating frames when source timing differs from the output frame grid.
Methods to choose/interpolate frames for different playback time; Pixel Motion can introduce warped artifacts.
Operation that freezes Roto Brush propagation for a selected span; not equivalent to exporting permanent alpha footage.
Roughly exclude unwanted region before precise keying/rotoscoping.
Speed or value graph for keyframes and interpolation.
Visible for internal composition work but generally excluded from its rendered parent-comp output (subject to context).
Widely used distribution codec, typically used in MP4 without a normal alpha channel.
Common compressed delivery codecs; strong distribution options, not ideal for every compositing source.
Keyframe interpolation choices: jump, constant interval interpolation, or curved interpolation.
Value stays at a key's level until next key, then jumps.
Beginning and end of a layer's visible span. Do not confuse with the Work Area limits `B`/`N`.
Definition used to interpret source color values correctly.
Common file extension for an After Effects ExtendScript script.
Spacing between a selected pair of characters.
Stored property value (and interpolation/tangent information) at a specified time.
Viewer for a single layer's source/paint/roto context.
Vertical distance between baselines of neighboring text lines.
In-between values change at a uniform numerical rate between keys.
Signal encoding in which a numerical pixel value corresponds approximately linearly to light intensity.
Expression function continuing a keyed pattern after its last keyframe.
Perceived image brightness; used for brightness-dependent mattes/effects.
Matte type that inverts luminance-derived transparency.
Matte type that derives target coverage from matte image brightness.
Lookup table used for a color conversion or artistic look; its meaning depends on source/target spaces.
Alpha boundary applied to a layer, with mode, path, feather, expansion and opacity.
High-quality intermediate media designed for additional editing/compositing.

quiz.question: Which file is the editable After Effects project?
quiz.explanation: The .aep stores compositions and references to other assets.

quiz.question: In 25.6, which 2026 command is not available?
quiz.explanation: Quick Apply started in 26.2; Quick Offset started in 25.4.

quiz.question: What does the layer Anchor Point define?
quiz.explanation: Anchor is the pivot in layer coordinates.

quiz.question: What does pressing U show on a selected animated layer?
quiz.explanation: U reveals animation-keyed properties.

quiz.question: Which shortcut trims selected layer IN at playhead?
quiz.explanation: Alt+[ trims; [ shifts the layer.

quiz.question: At 24 fps, how many frames are in 2 seconds?
quiz.explanation: Frames = seconds × FPS.

quiz.question: Which setting defines a composition frame grid?
quiz.explanation: The comp FPS determines output sample times.

quiz.question: What does a Hold keyframe do?
quiz.explanation: Hold interpolation jumps rather than smoothly interpolates.

quiz.question: Which graph shows the numerical rate of change?
quiz.explanation: Speed Graph is rate per unit time.

quiz.question: How do you animate a shape outline drawing on?
quiz.explanation: Trim Paths is a Shape Contents operator.

quiz.question: Which is a parametric shape property?
quiz.explanation: Rectangle Path preserves editable size and roundness.

quiz.question: What controls alpha coverage from another layer?
quiz.explanation: A matte source drives visibility of its target.

quiz.question: How does a Luma Matte differ from Alpha Matte?
quiz.explanation: Luma uses brightness; alpha uses transparency.

quiz.question: Which view is most helpful for matte quality?
quiz.explanation: Inspect alpha as a grayscale channel.

quiz.question: What happens if you click an active stopwatch?
quiz.explanation: It removes all property animation and keeps a current value.

quiz.question: What is a purpose of a Null?
quiz.explanation: Nulls are invisible transform/control layers.

quiz.question: Which operation changes nested render order?
quiz.explanation: Precompose can move effect/transform stages to another context.

quiz.question: What is an Adjustment Layer?
options: An effect processor for composited pixels below
quiz.explanation: It applies effects to underlying composited layers within context.

quiz.question: Which AE 26.x tool is absent in 25.6?
quiz.explanation: Object Matte debuted in 26.2.

quiz.question: Why track a checkerboard before final screen replacement?
quiz.explanation: Distinct grid corners expose perspective tracking errors.

quiz.question: Which tool is best suited to a planar moving sign?
quiz.explanation: Mocha tracks planar surfaces for corner-pin results.

quiz.question: What does Roto Brush Freeze do?
quiz.explanation: Freeze caches propagation, not final media delivery.

quiz.question: What does 32-bpc float provide?
quiz.explanation: Floating-point working precision can preserve extended values; it cannot recover clipped source.

quiz.question: Which came to AE with version 25.6?
quiz.explanation: Single 3D gizmo across selected 3D layers is 25.6.

quiz.question: Which is a 26.5-only upgrade?
quiz.explanation: Bundled OCIO 2.5.1/ACES 2.0 support was introduced in 26.5.

quiz.question: Which type can carry normal AE RGBA alpha more reliably?
quiz.explanation: Use a codec/format and output module that actually supports RGB+Alpha.

quiz.question: What is the difference between Output Module and Render Settings?
quiz.explanation: Output Module handles file options; Render Settings govern rendering.

quiz.question: Why use sourceRectAtTime for text cards?
quiz.explanation: Text bounds support auto-sized backgrounds.

quiz.question: What does `loopOut("cycle")` normally repeat?
options: A suitable animated property keyframe cycle
quiz.explanation: loopOut is property-oriented and depends on meaningful keyed animation.

quiz.question: What is the safer debugging first step for a slow comp?
options: Measure a short cold/warm preview and isolate effects
Turn off all render quality forever
quiz.explanation: Measure actual bottlenecks before deleting caches or replacing hardware.

quiz.question: What does Collect Files not promise to include?
quiz.explanation: Fonts and plugins require separate handoff checks.

quiz.question: How can you verify a render is correct?
options: Only see green Render Queue status
Open output separately and check frames/audio/alpha
quiz.explanation: Independent playback/reimport verifies the deliverable.

quiz.question: How do expressions differ from scripts?
options: Expressions drive individual property values, scripts edit projects
quiz.explanation: Expressions are time-evaluated formulas; scripts automate the application.

quiz.question: Which frame is frame :23 at 24 fps?
options: Last frame in that numbered second
quiz.explanation: Frames inside a second range from :00 through :23.

quiz.question: How many 25-fps frames correspond to 4 seconds?
quiz.explanation: 25×4=100 frames.
